messages:
SRE-Ops-Bot: PAGER -> p99 latency alert for /v1/chat/completions (us-west-2). route=chat.completions.model-group-A metric=p99_latency threshold=850ms current=1.9s sustained=3m impacted≈7% of requests; paging on-call.
Alex: seeing it. pinging Meera + Dan. opening a call if we need one.
Meera: pulling up the realtime panels — huge tail on one model shard. KV cache miss % jumped at same time.
Dan: I'll run quick network and LB checks.
Jordan (CS): two enterprise customers reported interactive chat slowdowns in the last 8–10 minutes.
Sam: grabbing inference worker logs and GC traces now.
Liz: suggestion: temporarily relax p99 alert to reduce pager noise while we triage. We could squelch p99 to 2.2s for the specific route for 30m, keep p95 alerting.
Alex: +1. Proposal: set p99 squelch to 2200ms on route=chat.completions.model-group-A for 30m and create a high-visibility ticket for tracking. Maintain p95 pages.
Meera: will scope squelch to route+model tag only.
SRE-Ops-Bot: Runbook tip: p99 spike + KV miss spike -> consider cache warmup, drain noisy worker, or route to fallback model. Suggested mitigations: increase cache parallelism, route a fraction to quantized fallback, enable tenant-level throttles.
Dan: LB/network checks look clean — latency appears server-side in decoder stage.
Sam: found a suspicious JVM GC pause ~1.2s on worker host worker-zz-73 around spike. Host: 10.4.2.73. Possible GC/heap compaction.
Meera: ok can we drain that host and let autoscaler replace it? Also reroute traffic off the affected shard.
Alex: executing drain now.
Alex: commands run:
```
kubectl cordon worker-zz-73 -n inference
kubectl drain worker-zz-73 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data -n inference
```
Meera: applying a 20% fallback routing to A-quantized variant to reduce tail latency.
Meera: routing snippet:
```
routing:
  route: "/v1/chat/completions"
  model_group: "A"
  fallback: "A-quant"
  weight: 0.2
```
Liz: applied alert change: p99 squelch -> 2200ms for route=chat.completions.model-group-A, duration=30m. Noted in incident ticket.
Alex: Jordan, please update the two affected customers that we're mitigating and expect improvement in ~15m.
Jordan (CS): sending update now.
Sam: host drained; replacement nodes being provisioned. Tail latencies on the affected shard trending down.
Meera: KV cache hit rate recovering; warmup progressing.
Dan: p95 back within SLO, p99 moved from 1.9s down to ~800ms over last 10m.
Alex: plan: keep squelch for remaining window (10m). If p99 <1s for 10m, we'll revert squelch and undo routing.
Liz: creating a temporary dashboard panel for per-model p95/p99 + KV cache hit rate to aid RCA.
Meera: dashboard created: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/incident/2441007777
SRE-Ops-Bot: Note logged: INCIDENT-2441007777 — actions: drained worker-zz-73, applied 20% fallback to A-quant, p99 squelch set to 2.2s. Severity=P2. Owners: Alex, Meera.
Alex: starting handoff prep; I'll hand to night on-call in 25m unless it re-escalates. Dan can you hang for 30m?
Dan: I can stay 30m. Page me if it regresses after that.
Jordan (CS): customers confirm improvements.
Sam: uploading heap dump + logs from worker-zz-73 to incident artifacts for RCA.
Liz: post-incident action items:
- revert squelch + routing if stable
- full postmortem: include KV cache regression and GC tuning
- add per-shard GC alert to avoid paging on a single-host GC
- implement an automated fallback when worker GC > 500ms
Meera: creating postmortem ticket: https://redwood.internal/pm/INC-2441007777 and assigning owners.
Alex: p99 steady ~650ms for 12m. Scheduling squelch removal and rollback of routing in 3m.
Liz: rollback scheduled; applying now.
SRE-Ops-Bot: rollback executed: routing weight -> 0, p99 squelch removed. Metrics will stabilize in ~2m.
Meera: confirming stability. Closing immediate pager. Collecting timeline for RCA.
Alex: handoff note to night on-call: watch p99 for chat.completions.model-group-A and GC/oom signals; runbook link added to incident ticket.
Jordan (CS): final customer updates sent; no ongoing impact.
Sam: artifacts uploaded to INCIDENT-2441007777/artifacts
Meera: marking incident resolved. Will schedule deeper RCA tomorrow. Closing thread.
